name: io.github.pranavnagrecha/sf-intelligence
description: Offline, read-only MCP knowledge base for a Salesforce org. Ask in plain language about schema, fields, Apex, Flows, permissions & sharing, integrations, OmniStudio, dependency/impact analysis, and code quality — grounded in the org's real retrieved metadata, never a guess. Private by design: answers are served from a local vault with no network egress.

runtimeArguments.description: Run the MCP server backing the local org-kb vault.
